design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 1 (whole_life_loans_dividends_and_values).
Step 0 draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 4]}. Assignment: accumulation interest credit 5 factors, anniversary dividend deposit 4, net surrender value 4.
WHY A GOOD TEST: Lorraine M. Whitfield asks only to complete the surrender she mailed. The net cash surrender value includes the accumulation deposit, which is not yet whole: two weeks after the 2026-09-21 anniversary neither the closed year's interest credit nor the 1,621.70 dividend deposit is on the ledger. The agent must read the surrender rule's two prerequisite sentences, find both gaps in the ledger, work out from the dividend rules which writes close them and in which order (the deposit waits on the credit), compute each with its factors, and only then compute the payout.
SCOPE: task 0 occupies the anniversary loan interest capitalization, the offset interest, the election accumulation withdrawal and the reduced paid-up face with their four tools. Task 1 claims whole_ext_accumulation_interest_credit, whole_ext_anniversary_dividend_deposit, whole_ext_net_surrender_value and the tools credit_accumulation_interest_b6da2e99, deposit_anniversary_dividend_704bd37e, complete_policy_surrender_23994b0e: different events (interest credit, dividend deposit, surrender/cash value paid) and a different root. Coverage after task 1: all seven extended policies and seven tools, pairwise disjoint.
PROBLEM TREE: root whole_ext_net_surrender_value (owner=user) <- whole_ext_anniversary_dividend_deposit (agent) <- whole_ext_accumulation_interest_credit (agent); root <- whole_ext_accumulation_interest_credit. Two prerequisite problems; value_input edges: surrender <- deposit and surrender <- credit (2 >= max(2-1,1)); deposit <- credit is a state_gate that pins the order of two writes sharing the deposit balance.
EDGE sentences: surrender <- deposit (affirmative): 'The net cash surrender value is fixed only after the accumulation ledger carries the deposit of the dividend declared at the most recent policy anniversary.' Only the deposit tool books deposit entries. surrender <- credit (negated): 'The net cash surrender value is not worked out until the accumulation ledger carries the interest credit for the policy year closed by the most recent anniversary.' Only the credit tool books interest credit entries (task 0's tools write capitalizations, offsets and withdrawals). deposit <- credit (affirmative): 'A dividend is placed on deposit at an anniversary only after the interest credit for the policy year that anniversary closes stands on the accumulation ledger.' Four-point test passed on each: ordering connective, record-visible ledger state, no tool/id/code token, hard requirement scoped to the most recent anniversary. Opening falsity: declaration row cb79f624-f2d9-46ae-8a4a-4357b43ed2dd (2026-09-21, accumulate) with the latest deposit row 32d8f820-f2cd-4aef-98bc-890b506eaccd dated 2025-09-21; latest credit row 6c90574c-d477-44cd-acc3-497ce1ad21e5 closing 2025-09-21.
PERSONA: organized retiree; volunteers only the goal (finish the surrender, get paid); identity on request; payout and withholding answers given only when asked and matching the request; blanket consent to bookings; confirms the surrender herself with the agent's details; ends after hearing the amount (the last gold action). Never mentions dividends, deposits or interest credits.
REACHABILITY: all writes synchronous at frozen_time 2026-10-05 10:15 EDT; the signed request already arrived (preexisting); nothing waits on clearing or review.
CONSISTENCY WITH TASK 0's WORLD: Kessler's historical interest credits and dividend deposits were generated with these same credit and deposit rules, so no seeded history in either task teaches a different algorithm.
DRAFT RECOMPUTE FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT: from the rule prose, docstrings, finder returns and persona lines alone the same three writes, order and arguments were rederived.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: credit and deposit subjects are governed by whole_dividends only (policy_scope). Surrender subjects are governed by whole_surrender, gate signed_surrender_request: request bcb88634-48d1-4de2-892b-360e49853c6b (surrender, signed 2026-09-29, received 2026-10-02) bound to whole_request_id; both beneficiary lines revocable, no assignee. Effective on the received date 2026-10-02. No time gate. Overrides declared: the anniversary-only accumulation interest clause (credit), 'accumulations are left on deposit' (deposit), the base gross/net cash value sentence (surrender: termination dividend, part-year accumulation interest, premium refund, loan indebtedness) and the base capitalization sentence for the surrender occasion (the surrender charges loan interest from the ledger's interest start and takes back a capitalization booked after that start, so it is never charged twice).
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: policy WL20739052 (b77f62e4-1c9b-4737-976c-645e059d330a), converted from LT20684195 (859b0f5e-8dab-4577-9848-f9d0278ceafa). Accumulation entries: 8 deposits 2018-2025, 7 credits 2019-2025, withdrawals 2025-10-03, 2025-11-14, 2026-09-24. Additions: 5 purchases 2013-2017, 9,726.25 face. Returned premium payments 2024-10-04 and 2025-12-29. Loan 3,000.00 advanced 2025-03-10, capitalized 84.14 on 2025-09-21, repaid in full 2026-01-15 (3,084.14 + 51.46 interest).
FACTOR CARD: credit — credit_large_deposit_increment (parameter): tier 'it is at least credit_band_floor_mid but below credit_band_floor_high' — ledger deposit 11,667.76 -> +0.0025; baseline 0. Baseline substituted -> result 366.32. | credit_long_deposit_increment (parameter): tier 'credit_deposit_count_mid or more but fewer than credit_deposit_count_long' — 8 deposit entries (2018..2025) -> +0.002; baseline 0. Baseline substituted -> result 372.53. | credit_withdrawal_frequency_reduction (parameter): tier 'two or more accumulation withdrawals dated within the 12 calendar months before the day the credit is processed' — withdrawals 2025-11-14 and 2026-09-24 within the 12 months before the 2026-10-05 processing day (2025-10-03 is 12 whole months back, outside) -> -0.005; baseline 0. Baseline substituted -> result 459.46. | credit_loan_activity_reduction (parameter): tier 'exactly one' — one loan advance (2025-03-10) within 24 months -> -0.005; baseline 0. Baseline substituted -> result 459.46. | credit_half_year_movements (method): tier 'accumulation withdrawals are dated within the 12 calendar months before the day the credit is processed' — withdrawals within those 12 months total 1,500.00 -> 750.00 added to the balance credited; baseline nothing added. Baseline substituted -> result 373.37. Whole baseline 437.54 vs 397.37.
  deposit — additions_dividend_method (method): tier 'at least one paid-up addition was bought more than deposit_additions_seasoning_months months before the deposit is processed' — 5 additions purchases (2013..2017), the oldest more than 36 months before the processing day -> apportioned by face: 9,726.25 face -> 157.7306; apportioned by reserve it would be 1,621.70 / 33,640.00 x 5,960.25; baseline none. Baseline substituted -> result 1597.37. | large_policy_increment (parameter): tier 'it is at least deposit_size_floor_mid but below deposit_size_floor_high' — base 100,000.00 + additions 9,726.25 = 109,726.25 -> +0.02; baseline 0. Baseline substituted -> result 1717.15. | interrupted_premium_reduction (parameter): tier 'exactly one' — one returned payment within the 12 months before the processing day (2025-12-29, row b405bb76-c190-4857-97dd-8ee547b0c179); the 2024-10-04 return is outside -> -0.05; baseline 0. Baseline substituted -> result 1841.71. | continuous_coverage_increment (parameter): tier 'they reach the 20-year count but not the 30-year count and the policy has never been reinstated' — term issued 1999-02-10 -> 331 months to 2026-09-21 -> +0.015; from the 2012-09-21 whole life issue date alone 168 months and no increase (near-miss); baseline 0. Baseline substituted -> result 1726.05. Whole baseline 1621.7 vs 1752.74.
  surrender — surrender_termination_dividend_scale (parameter): tier 'they reach the 20-year count but not the 30-year count and the policy has never been reinstated' — 331 months from the term issue date to 2026-10-02, never reinstated -> 0.015 of 33,640.00; from the whole life issue date alone 168 months -> none (near-miss); baseline none. Baseline substituted -> result 52540.62. | surrender_premium_record_cut (parameter): tier 'exactly one' — one returned payment within the 24 calendar months before the 2026-10-05 processing day (2025-12-29); the 2024-10-04 return (row df9d6879-20ee-4797-bd7b-e3ac40dc1c67) is 24 whole months back and outside -> share 0.8; baseline full. Baseline substituted -> result 52994.76. | unearned_premium_refund (method): tier 'the policy is billed quarterly or semiannually' — quarterly billing, paid to 2026-12-21, effective 2026-10-02 -> 2 whole months x 748.63 / 3; baseline nothing refunded. Baseline substituted -> result 52404.84. | surrender_accrual_start (method): tier 'an accumulation withdrawal is dated after the most recent anniversary' — withdrawal 2026-09-24 (row dc06fb57-702f-4de9-b0c1-91bc00c0909c) after the anniversary -> accumulation interest from 2026-09-24 (8 days); baseline from 2026-09-21 (11 days). Baseline substituted -> result 52907.77. Whole baseline 52045.37 vs 52903.93.
  Multi-source: continuous_coverage_increment and surrender_termination_dividend_scale. Cross-difficulty: both read the term holding's issue_date. Near-misses: whole-life-only coverage (168 months), the 2025-10-03 withdrawal and the 2024-10-04 return, each exactly 12/24 whole months before the 2026-10-05 processing day.
STANDARD SOLUTION: locate, verify, read policy/ledger/requests/term; credit 397.37 for 2026-09-21; deposit 1752.74 for policy year 14; hand over the surrender: request bcb88634-48d1-4de2-892b-360e49853c6b, effective 2026-10-02, direct_deposit, net 52903.93.
VERIFICATION RUN (gold replayed with real tools, check_compute's evaluator): credit 397.37 (baseline 437.54), deposit 1752.74 (baseline 1621.7), surrender 52903.93 (baseline 52045.37); edge skips: no deposit 51325.17, no credit 52546.0; credit after deposit 453.46.
FACTOR SENSITIVITY: credit credit_large_deposit_increment -> 366.32; credit_long_deposit_increment -> 372.53; credit_withdrawal_frequency_reduction -> 459.46; credit_loan_activity_reduction -> 459.46; credit_half_year_movements -> 373.37. deposit additions_dividend_method -> 1597.37; large_policy_increment -> 1717.15; interrupted_premium_reduction -> 1841.71; continuous_coverage_increment -> 1726.05. surrender surrender_termination_dividend_scale -> 52540.62; surrender_premium_record_cut -> 52994.76; unearned_premium_refund -> 52404.84; surrender_accrual_start -> 52907.77.
REVISIONS (round 2, policy-task audit): D-1/T1-F1/T1-F2 — the surrender premium-record window is now stated, like its compute, as the 24 calendar months before the day the surrender is processed; the 2024-10-04 return is 24 whole months before that day, so the rule and the gold agree (net unchanged). D-6/T1-F4 — the credit rule now states that every count and total is taken on the ledger as it stands on the processing day; the deposit window uses the same wording. D-3/T1-F3 — the additions dividend is now a genuine method: apportioned by face once any addition is more than 36 months old, by reserve (cash value) while all are newer. D-4 — the surrender deducts the loan balance and its accrued interest itself and the offset policy no longer covers a cash surrender. Whitfield's 2025 loan history was regenerated under the policy-form accrual convention (actual/365 for a 2012 form).
REVISIONS (round 3, policy-task audit revision 2): D-7 — the surrender's loan indebtedness now starts its interest at the latest interest-paying repayment where later than the stale paid-to date, takes the latest capitalization entry back out of the principal where it is dated after that start, and charges simple interest from there to the effective date; a pending anniversary capitalization booked before or never booked gives the same surrender payment (checked on task 0's ledger with a hypothetical surrender request: 56,772.52 both ways). This policy's ledger principal is 0.00 (3,000.00 + 84.14 - 3,084.14), so the gold net 52,903.93 is unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Lorraine M. Whitfield, 68, a retired school librarian living in Woodruff Place in Indianapolis. You are brisk and organized, you keep every Ashgrove letter in a folder, and you like to get to the point. You own an Ashgrove whole life policy on your own life; it began as a term policy you bought in 1999 and you converted it to whole life in 2012. Your children are grown and you would rather have the money now, so you have decided to cash the policy in. You signed the full surrender form on September 29 and mailed it, asking for the money by direct deposit and leaving the tax withholding box on the default. What you want today is to finish the surrender of your whole life policy and get the money paid out; you do not want to keep any coverage and you are not asking for a loan. You do not know the exact amount you will receive. You open by saying you are calling to complete the surrender of your whole life policy that you sent in last week. When the agent asks who you are, you give your name, Lorraine M. Whitfield, and your phone number, 3175550147. To verify your identity you give your date of birth, 1957-11-03, the last four digits of your Social Security number, 3826, and your ZIP code, 46201; only if one more detail is needed do you give your email, lorraine.whitfield@att.net. If asked for the policy number, it is WL20739052. If the agent asks how you want to be paid, the money goes the way you asked on the form, by direct deposit; if asked about tax withholding, you left the default on the form and that is fine. You are fine with the agent booking whatever has to be recorded on the policy before the surrender goes through, and you say so when asked. When the agent hands the surrender to you to confirm yourself, you complete it with exactly the details the agent gives you and read back what the confirmation shows. If the amount sounds lower or higher than you expected, you only ask whether that is really what the policy pays, and accept the answer. Once the surrender is confirmed and you have heard the amount being paid, you thank the agent and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The interest credit and the deposit share the accumulation balance, so their order is pinned by the deposit's prerequisite sentence ('A dividend is placed on deposit at an anniversary only after the interest credit for the policy year that anniversary closes stands on the accumulation ledger.'): crediting after the deposit would put the new dividend into the balance and the deposit count and give 453.46 instead of 397.37. The surrender comes last by its two prerequisite sentences. No other order is valid.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the deposit the surrender pays 51325.17 instead of 52903.93 and the 2026 dividend never reaches the deposit.
Without the interest credit the surrender pays 52546.00 instead of 52903.93 and the ledger lacks the 2026-09-21 credit.
State gate: if the deposit is booked first the credit computes 453.46 instead of 397.37; if the credit is skipped the terminal ledger lacks the credit entry.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only to complete the surrender and be paid; it never mentions dividends, deposits, interest credits or the anniversary, names no prerequisite policy, and reacts only with generic consent to bookings the agent says must come first.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: credit_accumulation_interest_b6da2e99, deposit_anniversary_dividend_704bd37e and complete_policy_surrender_23994b0e perform one create/update each with the arguments given and return a receipt; none checks the ledger, the request status or any other entry, and none returns an error.
